beats.en: Janapadas were territories of clans or tribes. In time larger and more powerful states emerged, the mahajanapadas, literally great realms. About sixteen are traditionally listed.

textbookBox.concept: Cities need technology. Iron tools, perfected in several regions from the early 2nd millennium BCE, took a few centuries to become part of everyday life.

beats.en: Cities need technology. Iron tools, perfected in several regions from the early 2nd millennium BCE, took a few centuries to become part of everyday life.
beats.speakEn: Cities need technology. Iron tools, perfected in several regions from the early 2nd millennium BCE, took a few centuries to become part of everyday life.

beats.en: A growing city needs many kinds of work: governance, administration, religion, education, trade, town planning, farming, crafts and arts. In an ideal society all these groups complement each other.
